title.en: Meta Q3 update · one-time legal charge
title.zh: Meta第三季度更新 · 一次性法律费用

note.en: Meta recorded a $9.89bn one-time legal settlement expense in Q3. Reported quarterly operating profit is $12.99bn, or $22.88bn excluding that charge. The agreement allows up to $18.59bn of payments over time; this is not the same as the current expense or unpaid liability.
note.zh: Meta第三季度计入98.9亿美元一次性法律和解费用。申报季度营业利润为129.9亿美元，剔除此费用后为228.8亿美元。协议允许分期支付最高185.9亿美元；总支付额不等于本期费用或尚未支付负债。

status.en: Provisional September TTM from the October 21 earnings release; the full September 10-Q is not yet filed.
status.zh: 9月TTM暂按10月21日业绩公告计算；9月完整10-Q尚未提交。

priorBase.en: This Q3 charge is outside the selected earlier financial period; no Q3 addback or settlement reserve is applied automatically to that earlier base.
priorBase.zh: 本次第三季度费用不属于所选较早财务期间；不会自动在较早基期加回第三季度费用或扣除和解储备。

normalization.en: Add back only the separately identified $9,890m Q3 legal settlement charge to starting EBIT. Reported GAAP EBIT remains unchanged; other legal, severance, AI and Reality Labs costs remain expenses.
normalization.zh: 起始营业利润仅加回单独披露的98.9亿美元第三季度法律和解费用。申报GAAP营业利润保持不变；其他法律、遣散、AI及Reality Labs成本仍保留为费用。

reserve.en: The unpaid settlement balance is not disclosed in the release. The researched case uses a $9,890m expense-anchored reserve proxy, deducted once, with $0 and $18,590m gross-claim sensitivities. This is not a reported liability or a verified bound on remaining payments; timing, taxes and amounts already paid are unresolved. Restricted cash is not netted against the claim.
reserve.zh: 公告未披露尚未支付的和解余额。研究情景以98.9亿美元费用金额为储备代理，仅扣除一次，并展示0及185.9亿美元总索偿敏感性。这不是申报负债，也不是剩余支付额的已验证边界；时间、税项及已支付金额仍未确定。不会以受限现金抵减该索偿。

shares.en: September actual common shares and unvested awards are absent from the release. The denominator carries June 30 common shares of 2,548m plus 146.464m unvested awards, not quarterly weighted-average EPS shares. A 1% denominator change moves per-share value by approximately 1% in the opposite direction.
shares.zh: 公告未披露9月实际普通股数及未归属奖励。分母沿用6月30日25.48亿股普通股加1.46464亿股未归属奖励，不采用季度EPS加权平均股数。分母变化1%会使每股价值约反向变化1%。

debt.en: September borrowings are $80,922m. Finance-lease debt is not separately disclosed, so the model adds the last reported $1,184m December 2025 liability as an explicit proxy. It is not a September liability measurement.
debt.zh: 9月借款为809.22亿美元。融资租赁负债未单独披露，模型明确沿用2025年12月最后披露的11.84亿美元负债作为代理，并非9月负债计量。

cash.en: Only $82,449m of unrestricted cash and current marketable securities enters the bridge. The $13,132m restricted cash balance is excluded. Earlier infrastructure escrow disclosures do not establish that restricted cash funds this legal settlement.
cash.zh: 估值仅加入824.49亿美元非受限现金及流动有价证券。131.32亿美元受限现金不计入。较早的基础设施托管披露不能证明这些受限现金用于本次法律和解。

split.en: A one-for-one Class C stock dividend is planned after the January 19, 2027 charter effective date. It is not applied to September shares or today’s pre-distribution per-share value; future Class A-only quotes will require a matching post-distribution share basis.
split.zh: 计划在2027年1月19日章程生效后按一比一派发C类股票股息。9月股数及当前派发前每股价值不作调整；未来单独A类报价需匹配派发后的股份口径。

summary.en: AI-supported advertising growth continues, while infrastructure investment remains heavy. The provisional Q3 TTM separates the one-time legal charge from recurring earnings and retains an explicit settlement-reserve estimate.
summary.zh: AI支持的广告增长持续，但基础设施投资仍然密集。暂定第三季度TTM将一次性法律费用与经常性盈利分开，并保留明确的和解储备估算。

growth.en: The 20% starting growth assumption remains below reported Q3 growth of 26%. Q4 revenue guidance is $73–76bn; guidance is context, not a substituted annual forecast.
growth.zh: 20%的起始增长假设低于申报第三季度26%的增长。第四季度收入指引为730至760亿美元；指引仅供参考，不替代年度预测。

margin.en: The 35% mature margin remains below the 36.95% TTM margin after removing only the Q3 $9.89bn legal charge. AI infrastructure, R&D, stock compensation, other litigation and Reality Labs remain costs.
margin.zh: 35%的成熟期利润率低于仅剔除第三季度98.9亿美元法律费用后的36.95% TTM利润率。AI基础设施、研发、股权薪酬、其他诉讼及Reality Labs仍保留为成本。

capital.en: The 0.5x incremental sales/capital assumption is unchanged: $2 of new net capital per $1 of added revenue. Management narrowed 2026 capex guidance to $135–145bn including finance-lease principal, reinforcing the capital-intensive interpretation.
capital.zh: 0.5倍新增销售资本比假设不变：每新增1美元收入需投入2美元净资本。管理层将2026年资本开支指引收窄至1,350至1,450亿美元（包括融资租赁本金），继续支持资本密集的判断。

preservedAnnualCase.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
preservedAnnualCase.summary: AI improves ad effectiveness, but a capital-intensive buildout and continuing new-business spending limit margin expansion.

rationale.growth: 22.1% in year 1, fading to 2.5% by year 10, tells the same story as the TTM case from the last full year: revenue reaches 454,306m USD in the twelve months to 2030-12-31, where the TTM case’s path is at that date.
rationale.targetMargin: 35% sits below the 38.1% TTM margin. It allows some normalization of legal/severance costs while retaining AI infrastructure, research and Reality Labs burdens.
rationale.tax: 20% is a long-run normalized rate, above management’s 15–17% remaining-2026 outlook; it avoids extending short-term credits or one-off tax adjustments forever.
rationale.salesCapital: 0.5x requires $2 of incremental net capital per $1 of added revenue. The high AI buildout and $130–145bn company capex outlook justify a capital-heavy starting case rather than an old asset-light advertising ratio.
rationale.terminalROIC: 12% retains a modest network/data advantage after competition and sustained infrastructure needs reduce historical excess returns.
rationale.wacc: 10.0% nominal USD is a rounded model estimate. Assumed beta 1.2, 10% target debt and a 1-point debt spread reflect advertising cyclicality, regulatory exposure and a rapidly expanding investment budget.
rationale.terminalGrowth: 2.5% nominal USD is a mature-state assumption with limited real expansion, well below the high-growth starting rate and the discount rate; it is not a company forecast.
rationale.years: 10 years is the common model horizon so company economics can be compared; rates and margins fade over this period. The number is a modeling convention, not a source fact.
rationale.otherClaims: No separately quantified additional claim was identified in the reviewed equity and award notes; reported stock awards are included in shares. This is a limited filing bridge, not a valuation of every litigation or future contractual commitment.
rationale.otherAssets: Add 27,524 million of nonmarketable equity investments. Publicly traded equity is already included in cash plus current marketable securities and is not added again.

reportedAnchors.classification: reported or directly derived from reported financials

waccBuild.classification: analyst model estimate; only riskFreeUSD is an observed input
waccBuild.equityRiskPremiumClassification: chosen long-run assumption; January reference is 4.23%, not a current estimate
waccBuild.formula: Ke = Rf + assumed beta × chosen ERP + extra equity risk; WACC = Ke × (1 − debt weight) + assumed Kd × (1 − tax) × debt weight
waccBuild.limits: Not a live beta regression, bond yield, market-value capital structure or country-default estimate. Extra equity allowances can overlap with operating downside; stress both rather than treating precision as evidence.

modelLimits: A smooth investment ratio cannot reproduce individual data-center projects or legal settlements.
uncertainties: Advertising demand, user engagement and monetization of AI features
Legal liabilities, privacy rules and returns on AI/Reality Labs spending

modelSuitability.note: An internally checked conditional model, not proof that business assumptions will be realized.

economicChecks.classification: computed consequences of assumptions; not reported outcomes or probabilities
economicChecks.note: Operating math only; the equity bridge uses the baseline’s sourced cash, debt, shares and claims.

otherAssets.locator: Consolidated balance sheet and Non-Marketable Equity Investments note: total carrying value; excludes publicly traded equity already within cash/current marketable securities.
otherAssets.note: Add 27,524 million of nonmarketable equity investments. Publicly traded equity is already included in cash plus current marketable securities and is not added again.

otherClaims.locator: Consolidated equity presentation and share-based compensation note; no separately quantified preferred equity, minority interest or outstanding option claim identified. Employee stock awards included in denominator. Finance leases included in debt or explicitly marked unknown.
otherClaims.note: No separately quantified additional claim was identified in the reviewed equity and award notes; reported stock awards are included in shares. This is a limited filing bridge, not a valuation of every litigation or future contractual commitment.
